reasonableness.draft_prompt: A small fairy writes a letter beside a round window, glossy cartoon 3D, half body.
reasonableness.revised_prompt: A small fairy with a human child face, smooth pointed ears, and warm cocoa-brown hair writes a letter in a warm dark room. The vertical 3:4 picture shows her from the waist up at eye level, turned three-quarters, looking down at the paper. She wears a lotus-pink dress with soft rounded folds. Her writing hand has a thumb and four separated fingers closed around a slim pen, and the nib touches a blank cream sheet. Her other hand rests flat on the sheet with separated fingers and a soft contact shadow. Both eyes sit at the same height, each with a warm amber iris, a white sclera crescent, and a bright catchlight. A single round window behind one shoulder is a warm golden circle, and the rest of the room is deep warm brown. The rendering is glossy cartoon 3D with thick rounded volumes, no hard ink outlines, warm saturated color, and soft gradient highlights on skin, hair, and cloth. Only this fairy, the round window, the letter, and the pen are in the picture. The paper shows no readable words.

lessons.drill: 从模块 palette 抽 3 HEX 做限色练习，禁止引入霓虹辅色

convergence_badge: 共 4 轮未达阈值，采用最高分
